notes: Kept beside valid/runs/migration-cjs-to-esm, the real run this fixture was standing in for. What it still covers is the far end of the workflow, which a run stopped at its first gate cannot reach: a migration_context whose current_system, target_system and migration_strategy are filled in as a completed migration leaves them, alongside the top-level external_research block. Synthesized originally from the migration orchestrator's own field set. One thing neither fixture covers, recorded here because it is easy to assume otherwise: a compliant migration run also writes task_context.clarifications_resolved beside migration_context, which A1's exactly-one-per-workflow-context rule refuses - the sampled fixture had those two lines removed by hand to land, and the unedited state is invalid/orchestrator-state/two-context-blocks. The conflict is filed, not fixed.
